app.name: Kindred
app.tagline: An AI agent who introduces you to one person at a time.

header.subtitle: AI Agent · One introduction at a time

chat.placeholder_first: Tell me about who you're looking for…
chat.placeholder_followup: Reply, or tell me what to change
chat.disclaimer: Mock profiles. Nothing leaves your browser.

understanding.title: What I've learned about you
understanding.empty: Tell me a bit about who you're looking for, and I'll keep track here. You can remove anything I got wrong.

intro.empty_hint: Not a list — one person at a time, with a reason. Tell me what you're looking for on the left, and I'll think.

letter.composer_subtitle: One careful letter. No read receipts.
letter.placeholder: Write to {{name}}. One specific thing — what made you stop on their page.
letter.err_quota: You've used today's letter. One per day — so it stays meaningful.
letter.err_inflight: You have three letters waiting. Wait for a reply before sending another.
letter.err_already: You've already written. Give them space to answer.
letter.waiting: Waiting on their reply. No need to refresh — I'll tell you.
letter.realtime_hint: You can chat freely now. Suggest meeting when it feels right.

inbox.title: Letters
inbox.empty: No letters yet. When you write to someone, the thread lives here.
